title: Semantic search over documents runs on PGlite's vector extension with content-hash re-embed skipping
content:
An `IProcessor` that embeds document content in-process with Transformers.js (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2` via ONNX) into PGlite's `vector` extension, answering cosine-similarity queries. No external API, no key, no server — pgvector runs inside PGlite.

The pipeline per batch:

1. Collect the **last operation per document** — earlier states are superseded, so intermediate revisions are never embedded.
2. Flatten the resulting document state into one string and truncate to the model's effective window.
3. **Hash the text and skip re-embedding when the hash is unchanged** — embedding is by far the most expensive step, and a processor that gets re-delivered history on backfill or restart would otherwise pay for it repeatedly.
4. Embed to a 384-dim vector and upsert into `semantic_index` (`embedding vector(384)`, HNSW index, cosine ops).
5. Handle `DELETE_DOCUMENT` by removing the row.

Queries go through `searchSimilar(text, k)`: embed the query with the same model, then `ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT k`. With normalized embeddings, `similarity = 1 - cosine distance`.

```ts
const pglite = new KyselyPGlite({ extensions: { vector } });  // vector ext is required
const db = new Kysely<SemanticSearchDB>({ dialect: pglite.dialect });
await up(db);

const processor = new SemanticSearchProcessor(db, embed);
const query = createSimilarityQuery(db, embed);
const results = await query.searchSimilar("budget allocation", 10);
```

Three pitfalls the recipe names: the embedding dimension is **baked into the column type**, and the processor asserts `embedding.length === 384` before insert so a model swap fails loudly rather than corrupting the index; long content is **truncated, not chunked** (cut at 2,000 characters — production systems should chunk into multiple rows); and HNSW defaults (`m=16`, `ef_construction=64`) are fine until many thousands of vectors.

**Directly self-relevant:** the recipe names [`@powerhousedao/knowledge-note`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@powerhousedao/knowledge-note) — the package this vault runs on — as "**the production proof of this stack**", and records one production-only divergence: knowledge-note **lazily `import()`s PGlite** so its processor and subgraph still register on deployments where transitive runtime deps are not installed. A Node-only recipe can use a plain import; a deployed package cannot count on that.

Provenance: academy `05-Lookup/00-Cookbook.md`, Semantic Search Processor recipe (auto-generated from `github.com/powerhouse-inc/recipes/tree/main/semantic-search`), academy 6.2.2-dev.45.
description: The Cookbook recipe stores 384-dim embeddings in a PGlite vector column with an HNSW cosine index and skips re-embedding when a document's content hash is unchanged.
